summary: Tested new Safety Team approval feature end-to-end (backend + frontend). Added /app/backend/tests/test_safety_approval.py with 34 pytest cases covering login role flags (170/121/158/IT admin/editors), PATCH /api/purchases/{id}/safety-approval RBAC, business-approval gating still restricted to 158/IT admin, safety user PUT branch (only safety_team_approved changes, other fields preserved), create-time approval gating for safety/editor/anonymous/business roles, XLSX/PDF exports include the new 'Approved by Safety Team' column, and regressions (anonymous basics-only, editor payment-only, no-token 401, pagination, stats). All 34 pass. Frontend Playwright: verified header shows both 'Business Approved' and 'Safety Approved' columns; role-based Add form fields (170: basics+safety checkbox only; 158: full incl. both checkboxes/date/bill; 16: payment only, no approval checkboxes); role-based row actions (170 has edit + safety-toggle, no delete/bulk-select/business-toggle; 158 has both toggles + delete + bulk; 16 has edit only, no toggles/delete); toggling Safety Approved as 170 flipped the badge Not Approved -> Approved and business badge was unaffected.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: stats endpoint only aggregates business_manager_approved; consider adding safety_team_approved counters if the UI will surface it (not requested).
Minor: CSV import HEADER_MAP has no mapping for 'Approved by Safety Team'; imports cannot set safety_team_approved. Consider adding a header alias if importing safety approvals is desired.

Minor: PurchaseTable.colCount uses canApprove but the table always renders the Safety Approved column, so skeleton colspan differs for safety-only viewers (170) — not visible in normal flow, cosmetic only.
seed_data_creation: Created (and cleaned up) TEST_-prefixed purchase records during test runs; final cleanup deleted TEST_C_ANON and TEST_ANON_R residuals.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_safety_approval.py is the authoritative regression for RBAC + Safety approval. Login toast overlaps the top-right Add Purchase button in Playwright; use page.evaluate('...click()') or ~3s wait after login before clicking Add. Anonymous can POST /api/purchases but backend forces payment='' and both approvals=false — verified. Safety users on PUT enter the 'else' branch and only safety_team_approved is written (basics preserved).
